title: Framework Comparison Chart
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners review a comparison chart of TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn, then choose the best framework for three realistic selection scenarios.

learningObjectives: Compare AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) based on their characteristics and use cases.
prerequisites: Machine Learning Frameworks section of Chapter 7

keyQuestions: Compare AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) based on their characteristics and use cases.
commonMisconceptions: One framework is best for everything.
Frameworks are only for data scientists.
assessmentOpportunities: Learner can name one strength of each framework.
